    # Simple sanity check against PyTorch's native Conv3d
    init_args = get_init_inputs()
    model = ModelNew(*init_args)
    x = get_inputs()[0]

    # Reference PyTorch result
    ref_conv = nn.Conv3d(
        init_args[0],
        init_args[1],
        init_args[2],
        stride=1,
        padding=0,
        dilation=1,
        groups=1,
        bias=False,
    ).to(torch.float16).cuda()
    with torch.no_grad():
        ref_conv.weight.copy_(model.weight)

    y_ref = ref_conv(x)
    y_tile = model(x)

    err = torch.max(torch.abs(y_ref - y_tile)).item()
    mismatched = (y_ref != y_tile).float().mean().item()
    print(f"Max absolute error: {err}")
    print(f"Fraction of mismatched elements: {mismatched}")
